decision: separate IndexedDB database with metadata and bytes object stores

stores.metadata: versioned GeneratedReportArtifact metadata envelopes keyed by artifact_id
stores.bytes: immutable report bytes keyed by artifact_id

why: Keeps generated bytes out of ProjectV2 and atom-planning-workspace.
Keeps metadata listing cheap without hydrating report bodies.
Works offline and needs no backend, database server, object store, or authentication.
Preserves the additive migration boundary established by Concept 7C.

rejected_for_7d.workspace_indexeddb: would mix evidence bytes with project metadata and violate the storage boundary
rejected_for_7d.filesystem_access_api: not consistently available across browsers and requires permission prompts
rejected_for_7d.metadata_only: would not support durable later-download behavior

relation_model: ReportDefinition remains project/domain metadata; GeneratedReportArtifact metadata and bytes remain artifact-store evidence. Runs are not mutated. RunArtifactReference is a future/read-only relation concept, while current artifact metadata carries run_ids.
export_boundary: ProjectV2 export does not include artifact bytes; a future evidence bundle may include report bytes, metadata, Run summaries, fingerprints, and a checksum manifest.

failure_policy.missing_bytes: metadata is marked missing and download is blocked
failure_policy.hash_mismatch: metadata is marked corrupt and bytes are never served as valid evidence
failure_policy.storage_write_failure: generated bytes remain available to the current download/print action and the UI states that local retention failed
failure_policy.quota: use navigator.storage.estimate when available; warn near 80 percent, fail explicitly at the browser quota, never evict silently
